bullets.text: A landslide warning was issued for the Withel terraces and Cranmoor area in Dreth on March 14, 2026, prompting evacuation efforts. Approximately 60 households were evacuated from the Withel terraces, with additional evacuations reported from Cranmoor. The event is being monitored as a mining-region landslide with contested attribution.

A warning was issued for the Withel terraces at 07:22:08 UTC and again at 07:24:25 UTC on March 14, 2026, followed by reports of approximately 60 households evacuated from the Withel terraces beginning at 07:29:35 UTC.
Approximately 60 households were evacuated from the Withel terraces, with additional evacuations from Cranmoor, as reported by multiple sources including NGOs and eyewitnesses.
A warning was issued for the Withel terraces and Cranmoor area due to landslide risk.
